note: What a server sends to take the match off hold. The header names a champion: in everything observed, that of the player who resumed the match.

fields.name: seat
fields.note: The player who resumed the match, announced in chat in their side's colour where their champion is known; 4294967295 announces no one.

bits.name: afterCountdown
bits.note: Set where the match starts again after a countdown rather than at once. Clear in everything observed, and play resumed at once.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

revisions.note: A client does not use the header. Resuming after the countdown, it keeps input locked and the pause panel open until a countdown of its own ends; resuming at once, it unlocks input and closes the panel.

fields.name: seat
fields.note: The seat that lifted the hold.

bits.name: afterCountdown
bits.note: Set where the match starts again after a countdown rather than at once. Set in everything observed.
